svg.title: Meron Matti
svg.desc: Meron Matti, full-stack developer and founder of Matti Studio. I build real software for real businesses. Also: an ordering system for a real cafe; AI phone agents for local businesses; an AI assistant that takes my calls; a finance app on my real bank data; an iOS app with 75+ TestFlight users. Computer Science at Oakland University, class of 2027. Now building Kyuu Cafe and Matti Studio.
